name: Supabase database (supabase-swift)
description: Reads and writes Postgres tables through the official supabase-swift client, with Codable rows, row-level security assumed, and a configuration message until keys are set.

credentialsNeeded.description: Your project's anon (public) key; protect data with row-level security

cost.note: Supabase has a free tier and paid plans; check current limits on its pricing page

usage: Create `SupabaseConfiguration.makeClient()` once at the composition root (nil until keys are set; show `SupabaseNotConfiguredView`). For each table define a `Codable & Sendable` row type and use `SupabaseTable<Row>(client:name:)` with `fetchAll()`, `insert(_:)`. Enable row-level security on every table; the anon key is public. Never put the service-role key in the app.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify supabase-backend` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
